query: What's the name of the fantasy film starring Sarah Bolger, featuring a New England family who discover magical creatures around their estate?

pipeline_result.response: The Spiderwick Chronicles is a 2008 American fantasy adventure film starring Sarah Bolger and set in New England.
retrieved_context: Sarah Bolger: Sarah Lee Bolger (born 28 February 1991) is an Irish actress.  She is best known for her roles in the films "In America", "Stormbreaker", and "The Spiderwick Chronicles", as well as her award-winning role as Lady Mary Tudor in the TV series "The Tudors", and for guest starring as Princess Aurora in "Once Upon a Time".

The Spiderwick Chronicles (film): The Spiderwick Chronicles is a 2008 American fantasy adventure film based on the bestselling book series of the same name by Holly Black and Tony DiTerlizzi.  It was directed by Mark Waters and stars Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger, Mary-Louise Parker, Martin Short, Nick Nolte, and Seth Rogen.  Set in the Spiderwick Estate in New England, it follows the adventures of Jared Grace and his family as they discover a field guide to faeries, battle goblins, mole trolls and other magical creatures.
